private_policy: Every other payload is private. This expressly excludes third-party extracted primary texts, all render/PDF copies, both extracted support packages, all kit archives, full native stdout/stderr/receipts, imported API captures, source versions and caches. No third-party primary PDF or full text is redistributed by this layer.
public_only_verifier_scope: Checks the public payloads and both bound manifest containers; private payloads are expressly unchecked. A relocated public layer may omit all private payloads but must retain PRIVATE_MANIFEST.json as an index without private content.
authorization: Proposed only; final local closure requires explicit parent approval. No publishing or upload is authorized by this plan.
